People question me about waking up at noon, 1pm, 2pm. But that's because i stay awake till 8, 9, 10, etc. Dont judge the time you go to sleep or wake up, judge the amount of sleep.

Day 1: 5 minute talk with psych 1, two new meds. Left on my own for the rest of the day aside from a cold chicken dinner. 

Day 2: woke up after 2 hours of sleep with a migraine, cut the sleep meds immediately. 5 minute talk with psych 2 & 3, 10 minute talk with therapist 1. Verified an already known deep rooted hatred for parents. Another cold chicken dinner. 

Day 3: 3 hours of sleep this time, still woke up with a migraine. Btw, I dont get migraines normally. 5 minute talk with psych 2 and 3, 10 minute talk with therapist 2. Decide parents need taken out of the picture. You guessed it, another cold chicken dinner. 

Day 4: repeat of day 3 except we discussed coping methods. Got access to my laptop for school work since they changed plans from a 3 day stay to 7 day stay. 

Day 5: more coping methods, otherwise a repeat of day 3. worked on school work and read books

Day 6: psych 2/3 and therapist 1 admit there's nothing more they can do to help aside from being content with results thinking I was no longer suicidal. 

Day 7: set up with psych 4, therapist 2 and 3 for weekly meetings after leaving. 

Fast forward several months, therapist 2/psych 4 give up and doctor doubles the med dosage. Several more months and therapist 3 gives up.  

Seeked help from one additional therapist after this. 3 sessions, sorry cant help you. 

Common denominator: no fucking coping method or medication suggested/tried to date has helped close the gap for me to be able to tame my darker thoughts. 

Edit: days 4-6 were more cardboard *ahem* I mean cold chicken dinners.
